	}

		monthly_agricultural_tax = textiles_income_tier_1_tribal
	}

		trade_good_silk_sell_price_mult = price_textiles_silk_building
	}

		trade_good = trade_good_silk
		amount = textiles_silk_need_per_level
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_textiles_production_add = textiles_output_per_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_textiles_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_textiles_level_tribal
			}
		}
	}

	on_complete = {

	}

	next_building = textiles_silk_building_2

	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_textiles }

		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_textiles }
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}

		monthly_artisan_tax = floss_spinnery_income_tier_5_tribal
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_silk }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_silk }
		ai_resource_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 5 }
	}

}

	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 3
        if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active } value = 0 }
    }
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost
	province_modifier = {
		prosperity_growth = low_prosperity_tier_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good_category = trade_category_fabrics
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = half_silk_artisan_tax_per_fabrics_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = half_silk_artisan_tax_per_fabrics_need_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_silk
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			character_modifier = {
				monthly_prestige = half_silk_prestige_per_silk_need
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = half_silk_weavery_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/leather_buildings.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_consumer_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_silk CATEGORY = trade_category_fabrics }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}

}
